node.title: Rate-half MCA near-rational line BC-guard rejection
node.statement: For each of the 67472 displayed support-wise bad slopes in the deployed KoalaBear near-rational counterexample of upstream #1160, the slope word is supported on exactly 67471 coordinates. Its support locator and zero numerator form a received-word lattice vector of effective shifted degree 67471. Therefore the minimum shifted degree is below the necessary 67472 lower guard in the cycle-19 candidate P_BC certificate contract, and every displayed slope is rejected. This passes the mandatory hostile regression at guard level but proves no equivalence with the frozen BC owner.
